svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Post: 60 x 60 x 4 mm RHS, 926.5 mm long, square ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base plate 200 x 100 x 10 mm: four 11 mm holes on a 75 x 140 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rectangle (75 mm along the frame, 140 mm across it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap plate 120 x 80 x 10 mm: two 11 mm holes on the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 80 mm apart (40 mm each side of the post).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the post to the middle of both plates, square both ways;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check with a square before the welds cool.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left post only: two 11 mm holes across it, 550 and 700 mm up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the frame top, for the tool shelf's two M10 through-bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the base bolts across the two end cross members of the frame

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with 4 x M10 x 80; the rail beam sits on the cap and is held by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M10 through-bolts. Post centre 712.5 mm from the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: post upright within 1 mm over its height when bolted.
